title: Bombardiro Crocodilo
blurb: A crocodile fused with a bomber aircraft, narrated in that unmistakable synthetic Italian voice, and one of the flagship characters of the whole movement. It illustrates the genre perfectly: nobody asked for a flying reptile with a fuselage, nobody can satisfactorily explain the appeal, and yet the view counts run into the billions. The 2025 Italian brainrot wave moved faster than any meme cycle before it, spawning a shared universe with factions, rivalries and fan-made lore. Play it to be immediately understood by anyone under fifteen and immediately misunderstood by everyone else.
origin: One of the flagship Italian brainrot AI characters.
